description: This file defines an enum 'ExecShellWrapperParser' with methods and data structures for identifying and extracting shell command wrappers from command-line inputs. It offers functionality to detect whether a command is a shell wrapper (like bash, cmd, PowerShell), and to extract the inner command payload.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser
classes.description: A static enum serving as a namespace for related parsing functions and data structures.

classes.name: ParsedShellWrapper
classes.description: A struct representing whether a command is a shell wrapper and its extracted command string.

classes.name: Kind
classes.description: An enum representing different shell types (posix, cmd, powershell) used internally for parsing.

classes.name: WrapperSpec
classes.description: A struct pairing a shell 'kind' with a set of shell names (aliases) to identify wrapper commands.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Public method to process a command array and optional raw command string, returning a ParsedShellWrapper indicating if it's a shell wrapper and its payload.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Internal method to determine the payload of the command based on the wrapper spec's kind.

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Internal method to extract inline commands from POSIX shell wrappers.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Internal method to extract inline commands from Windows 'cmd' shell wrappers.

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Internal method to extract inline commands from PowerShell wrappers.
